question: Red Sanders, an endemic tree species, is restricted to which of the following Indian physical divisions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern Ghats**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red Sanders** is an endemic tree species primarily found in the **Eastern Ghats** of India.
 
• It is known for its rich red color and is highly valued for its wood, which is used in making furniture, musical instruments, and other artifacts.
 
• The Eastern Ghats region provides the suitable climate and soil conditions required for the growth of Red Sanders.
 
• Conservation efforts are in place to protect this species, as it is listed under the **Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Eastern Ghats** are a discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast, extending from West Bengal in the north to Tamil Nadu in the south.
 
• The region is known for its rich biodiversity and is home to various endemic species of flora and fauna.
 
• Red Sanders, also known as **Pterocarpus santalinus**, is a species of flowering tree in the Fabaceae family.
 
• Due to its over-exploitation, Red Sanders has been classified as endangered by the **International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)**.
 
• Efforts are being made to restore its population through sustainable harvesting and reforestation programs.
